title: System manifest
description: Tells tools such as Flags Explorer how to build links to the dashboard of a flag management system (system), from the variables of a connection of the Flags SDK. URL templates use level 1 of RFC 6570: {name} placeholders, which are replaced with URL-encoded values. A placeholder must not be in the origin.

logo.description: The URL of the logo of the platform.

variables.description: The variables which the connections give, e.g. projectId. The variable flagKey is always available in the link of a flag.

flag.description: The page of one flag. Has the variable flagKey.

createFlag.description: The page which creates a flag.

template.description: An HTTPS URL template, without a placeholder in its origin.
